name: lv_obj_set_local_style_prop_xip_thunk

ownership.argument: Borrowed live LVGL object in r0, style property id in r1, 32-bit property value in r2, style selector in r3.
ownership.return_value: No ownership transfer. The setter may allocate the widget's native local style and synchronously refresh the widget.

provenance.source: Exact xiaomi-band-10-pro-3.101.043 AP bytes: eight-byte XIP veneer (`ldr pc, [pc, #-0]`) whose literal is 0x2bd925, the startup-copied SRAM image of lv_obj_set_local_style_prop (flash load image at 0xc107790).

notes: Audited ABI: void(void *obj, uint32_t property, uint32_t value, uint32_t selector). Reaches the SRAM copy of lv_style_set_prop and its memmove; the flash load image of the same function calls a memmove at 0xc0c0684 that is zero-filled in vela_ap.bin.
